name: stab_rate_d_yaw
description: Stabilized lab flow on ATLAS_OG with flat nose brackets: rate D (roll and pitch together via two variables) and yaw rate P. 3x3x2 grid.
objective: phases.hover.pitch_err_rms_deg + phases.hover.roll_err_rms_deg + 0.05 * phases.hover.rates_rms_deg_s + 0.2 * (phases.liftoff.pitch_max_deg + phases.liftoff.roll_max_deg) + 0.2 * (phases.landing.pitch_max_deg + phases.landing.roll_max_deg) + 2 * phases.nose_lower.touchdown_speed + 5 * metrics.saturation_fraction
